infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GeoField Camera uses your precise location to record the exact coordinates of each fieldwork photo.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your camera to capture fieldwork photos.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your precise location to geotag fieldwork photos.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your photo library so geotagged photos can be organized into an album.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to save geotagged photos to your gallery.
